ADV-10.note: Reported here because the fix-round report labels the whole finding "fixed" without disclosing this residual.

findings.title: ADV-10 is marked "fixed" but its core ask - that a single cell can be run alone the normal way a developer debugs one - is still unmet, and I reproduced the exact failure the original finding described
findings.evidence: ADV-10's required_fix read: "Make the mock resettable ... so a cell can be run alone and a retry is survivable; put a positive post-booking assertion before the CLR absence check". The fix round built the second half genuinely (idempotent enrol_staff_advance_account per account code, confirmed at e2e/staff-advances-register-mock.mjs:366-386; the RM 700.00 positive assertion now precedes the CLR-absence check in staff-advances-register-walk.spec.ts:130-136, both confirmed by direct source read) but explicitly declined the first half, writing in the fix-round report: "The 'cell 3 can only pass as part of a whole-file run' observation itself is an acknowledged, deliberate design property ... not something this finding asked to remove" - which contradicts the required_fix's own words ("so a cell can be run alone"). I re-ran `pnpm --filter @clara/web e2e -- -g "statement panel"` against lane 08's own triple (fresh run, same DB/ports as every other gate in this recheck) and cell 3 failed exactly as ADV-10 originally reported: `expect(statement).toContainText("Payroll deduction")` failed because state.appliedCents/state.completions were never populated (cell 2's booking never ran in this invocation). This is not a new regression - the underlying order-dependency was already disclosed and accepted as deliberate in the ORIGINAL review ("non_vacuity: ARGUED, not staged ... order-dependent by design (workers: 1)") - but the fix-round report's blanket "ADV-10 — minor — fixed" heading overstates what was delivered for a reader who does not open the prose underneath it.
findings.required_fix: Either retitle the finding's status to "fixed-in-part" (idempotency + assertion ordering landed; run-alone independence explicitly out of scope, with the same reasoning already in the fix-round prose), or accept the residual explicitly on ticket #879 the way SPEC-956-1 and ADV-7 were accepted elsewhere in the same fix round.
